aurorion_intencao.hud.mesa: the scene is played at the Discord table · %s
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.1: Every will has a price. Someone here does not know theirs yet.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.2: The glass remembers who knelt before it.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.3: Strength does not decide. Whoever looks away first does.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.4: An old echo whispers a name that is not yours.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.5: Here, a lie weighs more than a sword.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.6: You have been here before. You just don't remember losing.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.7: Intention that hesitates becomes desire. Desire that hesitates becomes longing.
aurorion_intencao.fragmento.8: The Houses are watching. None of them forgives doubt.
